Well, nice try, but only half a bannana.  This takes care of
restoring register T if a TTY interupt occurs during tty-input 
wait (and maybe the file array moved around), but it doesn't
take care of flow-of-control decisions made on the basis
of an empty buffer-back list (FI.BBC).  This is the root
of the JLS weirdo wherein " IJK" gets contorted into "I JK".
Maybe I can fix this today.
